facts.fact: Le Jour reports that on 23 October 2025, during the presidential election, Cameroon had internet restrictions that blocked a blogger's access to Facebook and publishing, described as a government decision; no end date is given.
facts.system: Facebook access restriction during the 2025 presidential election

facts.fact: Civic Watch Cameroon's head and other participants at a 8-9 June 2026 Yaounde workshop on the 2010 cybercrime law (law n°2010/012) said it contains provisions limiting free expression, and legal experts and civil society called the October 2025 election-time internet restrictions a rights violation.
facts.system: Law n°2010/012 of 21 December 2010 on cybercrime and the October 2025 internet restrictions

systems.system: Law n°2010/012 of 21 December 2010 on cybercrime
